text: Haverbrook Tickets is an online event-ticket marketplace with about 500,000 monthly active users buying tickets to concerts, sports, and theater.
Two services, catalog-api and checkout-api, live in one GitHub repo -- but today they only run on developers' laptops, with no cloud infrastructure at all.
Deploys are manual and risky, and there's no real production monitoring -- nobody would know something broke until a customer complained.
Celeste Marchbanks, VP of Engineering, sponsors this project -- she wants safe, automated deploys and real visibility into production health.
Next: turning 'ship safely and know when it breaks' into one precise, testable requirement.
